findings.note: The Devils' preview says Werenski leads Columbus with 15 assists and has a four-game point streak (3G, 3A). It also lists Blue Jackets forwards Sean Monahan (upper body) and Conor Garland (IR) as injured, which could cut his assist chances. Devils defensemen Kovacevic and Casey are also out.

A Rotowire note from Nov 22 says Werenski had a goal and an assist against Toronto, his fourth straight game with a point (6 points). The same page lists Columbus as a heavy road underdog (NJ -206, total 6), which could limit his chances to get assists.

ESPN's team stats show Columbus scoring only 2.48 goals per game, which works against the bet. Working for it, New Jersey has a 64.2% penalty kill, and both of its listed goalies have save percentages below .900.
